name: Annual Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a job offer from a Bahamian-licensed employer, for a period exceeding 90 days.

Employer must obtain a Labour Certificate with Notification of Vacancy from the Department of Labour, and place newspaper advertisements for three consecutive days in a nationally circulated paper, to demonstrate no suitably qualified Bahamian is available -- required for all positions except top Immigration Fee Scale 1 roles and certain Scale 2 roles.
requirements.fix_path: Employer completes the labour-market test (Labour Certificate plus newspaper advertisements).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an original medical certificate (within 30 days) and an original police certificate (within 6 months, covering 5 years' residence; required for applicants 14+).
requirements.fix_path: Obtain qualifying medical and police certificates.

evidence_required.document: Labour Certificate with Notification of Vacancy
Two written references from previous employers

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Work Permit (New): eligibility for stays exceeding 90 days, $200 processing fee, labour-market test (Labour Certificate + 3-day newspaper advertisement) required for most Fee Scale positions, medical/police certificates, 8-12 week processing, dependents apply separately for Permit to Reside

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. Work permits are graded into Immigration Fee Scales (1 = most senior/exempt from labour-market test, through 8 = domestic workers, subject to tightened Labour Certificate rules from September 2025) -- this route models the general/median case rather than every scale variant. pr_after_months (240 = 20 years) reflects the 'Work Permit Holders' category in bs_permanent_residence_general.json requiring 20+ consecutive years on permit status, the most direct switchable pathway found; dependents require a separate Permit to Reside application (not modelled as its own route in this build).
